contacts_old:
SELECT
                contact.id,
                contact.display_name,
                (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM public.message AS message
                    WHERE message.owner_id = contact.owner_id
                      AND message.contact_id = contact.id
                      AND 
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.message_source_ref AS ref
        WHERE ref.message_id = message.id
          AND ref.owner_id = message.owner_id
          AND ref.contact_id = message.contact_id
          AND (
              (
                  ref.source_document_id IS NOT NULL
                  AND EXISTS (
                      SELECT 1
                      FROM public.source_document AS source
                      WHERE source.id = ref.source_document_id
                        AND source.owner_id = ref.owner_id
                        AND source.contact_id = ref.contact_id
                        AND source.status = 'active'
                  )
              )
              OR ref.observation_id IS NOT NULL
          )
    )
    
                ) AS message_count,
                (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM public.source_document AS source
                    WHERE source.owner_id = contact.owner_id
                      AND source.contact_id = contact.id
                      AND source.status = 'active'
                ) + (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM public.local_wechat_observation AS observation
                    WHERE observation.owner_id = contact.owner_id
                      AND observation.contact_id = contact.id
                ) AS source_count
            FROM public.contact AS contact
            WHERE contact.owner_id = %s
            ORDER BY contact.created_at, contact.id
contacts_new:
SELECT c.id AS contact_id,c.display_name,
        json_build_object('message_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.message m WHERE m.owner_id=c.owner_id AND m.contact_id=c.id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.message_source_ref ref WHERE ref.owner_id=m.owner_id AND ref.contact_id=m.contact_id AND ref.message_id=m.id AND (
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.source_document s WHERE s.owner_id=ref.owner_id AND s.contact_id=ref.contact_id AND s.id=ref.source_document_id AND s.status='active') OR
    EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.local_wechat_observation o WHERE o.owner_id=ref.owner_id AND o.contact_id=ref.contact_id AND o.id=ref.observation_id)))),
        'source_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_document s WHERE s.owner_id=c.owner_id AND s.contact_id=c.id AND s.status='active')+(SELECT count(*) FROM public.local_wechat_observation o WHERE o.owner_id=c.owner_id AND o.contact_id=c.id)) AS data_status
        FROM public.contact c WHERE c.owner_id=%s ORDER BY c.created_at,c.id
scope_revision:
SELECT c.xmin::text AS revision,
    (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(b.id,b.xmin::text) ORDER BY b.id),'[]') FROM public.conversation_binding b WHERE b.owner_id=c.owner_id AND b.contact_id=c.id) AS bindings,
    (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.xmin::text ORDER BY x.id),'[]') FROM public.owner_channel_identity x WHERE x.owner_id=c.owner_id) AS accounts,
    (SELECT x.xmin::text FROM public.front_sync_state x WHERE x.owner_id=c.owner_id) AS sync_switch,
    (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.xmin::text ORDER BY x.channel,x.account_scope),'[]') FROM public.wechat_sync_scope x WHERE x.owner_id=c.owner_id) AS sync_scope,
    (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.xmin::text ORDER BY x.channel,x.account_scope),'[]') FROM public.wechat_history_sync_authorization x WHERE x.owner_id=c.owner_id) AS history_grants,
    (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.xmin::text ORDER BY x.channel,x.account_scope,x.locator_hash),'[]') FROM public.wechat_sync_exclusion x WHERE x.owner_id=c.owner_id) AS exclusions,
    (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.xmin::text ORDER BY x.id),'[]') FROM public.source_document x WHERE x.owner_id=c.owner_id AND x.contact_id=c.id) AS sources
    FROM public.contact c WHERE c.owner_id=%s AND c.id=%s
sources:
SELECT source.id AS source_id,source.file_name,source.record_count,source.status,
        task.id AS task_id,task.status AS task_status,task.current_step AS step,
        COALESCE(task.last_error_code,source.deletion_error_code,CASE WHEN source.status='deleted' AND task.id IS NULL THEN 'legacy_deletion_unverified' END) AS error_code
        FROM public.source_document source LEFT JOIN public.background_task task ON task.owner_id=source.owner_id AND task.contact_id=source.contact_id AND task.source_document_id=source.id AND task.task_type='delete'
        WHERE source.owner_id=%s AND source.contact_id=%s ORDER BY source.imported_at DESC,source.id
sources_old:
SELECT source.id, source.file_name, source.record_count,
                           source.status, task.id, task.status, task.current_step,
                           COALESCE(task.last_error_code, source.deletion_error_code,
                             CASE WHEN source.status = 'deleted' AND task.id IS NULL
                                  THEN 'legacy_deletion_unverified' END)
                    FROM public.source_document AS source
                    LEFT JOIN public.background_task AS task
                      ON task.owner_id = source.owner_id AND task.contact_id = source.contact_id
                     AND task.source_document_id = source.id AND task.task_type = 'delete'
                    WHERE source.owner_id = %s AND source.contact_id = %s
                    ORDER BY source.imported_at DESC, source.id
